title: Automatic Release
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:16 AM

Automatic Release

Use

You want to release receivables for collection in other business transactions.

Integration

The release of receivables for collection is integrated in the following business processes:

e Dunning
e Write-off

e Write-off in mass run

Key Features

If you make the relevant system settings, items that have reached a certain dunning level are automatically released for collection.

If you select the Release Receivables for Submission to Collection Agency indicator during manual write-off or in the write-off

run, the receivables written off are automatically released for collection.

During the release, the programs determine the items to be released, release the positions, and set the submission status 01
(Receivable Released for Submission). The document is given the collection item number OO1. The collection agency is
determined in event 5060.

Activities
Dunning

If you want to release items automatically in the dunning run, in Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable, under
Business Transactions » Dunning Notices» Configure Dunning Activities “, define a relevant dunning activity and enter the

function module FKK_COLL_AGENCY_RELEASE_0350 for this activity. The function module is processed in the dunning run. If the
dunning level is reached, the module selects the items and releases them automatically. See also the documentation for the
Customizing activity.

Write-Off

1. In the SAP Easy Access menu, choose |sAccount . Write Off Items “J (transaction FP04).

2. Then proceed as described in the section Writing Off Items.
Mass Write-Off

1. In the SAP Easy Access screen, choose |}*Periodic Processing » For Contract Accounts » Write-Off Run 3 (transaction
FPO4M).

2. Then proceed as described in the section Writing Off Items in Mass Runs.
